target.title: fix(config): preserve empty env var values in config resolution
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves
Fixes two related issues where `resolveConfigValue` / `resolveConfigValueUncached` use `||` (boolean OR) instead of `??` (nullish coalescing), causing an explicitly-set empty environment variable to fall through to the literal config key name.

**Bug 1 — resolver fallback semantics**: When `MY_API_KEY=""`, the `||` operator treats empty string as falsy and returns the literal `"MY_API_KEY"` as the API credential. This produces a confusing "invalid API key" error from the provider instead of a clear "not configured" failure.

**Bug 2 — auth status disagreement**: `ModelRegistry.getProviderAuthStatus` uses a plain truthiness check (`if (process.env[key])`) that treats empty env vars the same as absent env vars. After the `??` fix, the runtime resolver returns `""` (treated as missing auth), but the status path still reports `configured: true, source: "models_json_key"`. A custom provider can appear configured in status while runs fail as missing auth.

## Why This Change Was Made
- Replaced `||` with `??` in both `resolveConfigValue` and `resolveConfigValueUncached` so that an explicitly-set empty environment variable is preserved rather than silently reinterpreted as a literal config string.
- Updated `getProviderAuthStatus` to use `in` operator to distinguish "env var set to empty" from "env var not set", and return `configured: false` when the env var is explicitly empty — aligning status with the runtime resolver.

## User Impact
Users who accidentally leave an API key env var set to empty will now get a clear "API key not configured" error (both at runtime and in status checks) instead of a confusing "invalid API key" error from their provider.

## Real behavior proof

**Real environment**: Linux x86_64, Node 24, OpenClaw main + fix branch. Proof drives real production `resolveConfigValue`, `ModelRegistry`, and `AuthStorage` through a temporary `models.json` file on disk — no mocks of tested functions.

### Full-chain proof output
```
[case 1] resolveConfigValue: empty env var with || (pre-fix behavior)
  ok: || returns key name as value (BUG)
    buggy result: "OPENCLAW_PROOF_EMPTY_KEY" (used as API key!)
  ok: ?? returns empty string (FIXED)
    fixed result: ""
  ok: ?? uncached returns empty string (FIXED)
[case 2] resolveConfigValue: env var set to real key
  ok: real env value returned correctly
[case 3] resolveConfigValue: env var not set (literal fallback)
  ok: missing env falls back to literal key name
[case 4] ModelRegistry.getProviderAuthStatus: empty env-backed apiKey
  ok: empty env -> configured: false
    status: {"configured":false}
  ok: getApiKeyAndHeaders returns empty apiKey (not key name as apiKey)
    apiKey result: ok=true, apiKey=""
[case 5] ModelRegistry.getProviderAuthStatus: real env-backed apiKey
  ok: real env -> configured: true, source: environment
    status: {"configured":true,"source":"environment","label":"OPENCLAW_PROOF_EMPTY_KEY"}
[case 6] ModelRegistry.getProviderAuthStatus: missing env (literal fallback)
  ok: missing env -> configured: true, source: models_json_key
    status: {"configured":true,"source":"models_json_key"}
[case 7] ModelRegistry.getProviderAuthStatus: shell command apiKey
  ok: shell command -> configured: true, source: models_json_command
    status: {"configured":true,"source":"models_json_command"}

ALL PROOF ASSERTIONS: 10 passed, 0 failed
```

### Negative control (pre-fix `||` on origin/main)
```
Pre-fix: empty env -> "OPENCLAW_PROOF_KEY" <- BUG: returns key name!
Pre-fix uncached: empty env -> "OPENCLAW_PROOF_KEY" <- BUG: returns key name!
---
Fixed: empty env -> "" <- FIXED: returns empty string
Fixed uncached: empty env -> "" <- FIXED: returns empty string
```

### vitest (10 tests, all pass)
```
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  10 passed (10)
```

### Behavior matrix
| Scenario | Pre-fix resolver | Pre-fix status | Fixed resolver | Fixed status |
|----------|-----------------|----------------|----------------|--------------|
| Env var = "sk-real" | "sk-real" | configured: true, env | "sk-real" | configured: true, env |
| Env var = "" | "MY_KEY" (key name!) | configured: true, models_json_key | "" | configured: false |
| Env var absent | "MY_KEY" (literal) | configured: true, models_json_key | "MY_KEY" (literal) | configured: true, models_json_key |

### Files changed
- `src/agents/sessions/resolve-config-value.ts`: `||` -> `??` (2 chars x 2 sites)
- `src/agents/sessions/model-registry.ts`: `getProviderAuthStatus` empty-env handling
- `src/agents/sessions/resolve-config-value.test.ts`: +87 lines, 10 test cases
- `proof-config-empty-env.mts`: standalone full-chain proof script (188 lines)
